name: 44612-longaudio-whisperturbo-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1); the host needs ~10 GB of free RAM for audio buffers at this concurrency.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup 10% by request count, bound 384 requests, safety cap 2400 s.
workload: Long-form ASR over HTTP: multipart POST to /v1/audio/transcriptions, one audio file per request, no text prompt, language=en, temperature=0.0, no max_tokens, generated to EOS. Six English earnings calls from ArtificialAnalysis/Earnings22-Cleaned-AA (ungated, apache-2.0; mp3, 24 kHz mono 64 kbps, 875-1344 s, mean 1149.2 s), cycled to fill the run.
purpose: An audio transcription service turning hour-long English earnings calls into text for 128 concurrent uploads on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's whole launch line: `vllm serve $MODEL --trust-remote-code`. Every other engine
# setting is the default at this commit; the load is not in this file.
model: openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo
tensor-parallel-size: 1
trust-remote-code: true
